name: SiteFerry – Migration & Backup
author: Sufiyan Khan

sections.description:
Move, clone or back up your WordPress site — any size, completely free.

SiteFerry copies everything — database, media, plugins, themes and the rest of wp-content — and recreates an exact, working copy of your site on another server, domain or local computer. No size limits, no paid extensions, no “upgrade to unlock” screens. No sign-up, no fuss.

And SiteFerry never leaves you with a broken site. It tests the imported site straight away, puts your previous site back automatically if it crashes, and keeps an undo button ready for 48 hours.

Why site owners choose SiteFerry

  • Unlimited and free. Migrate multi-gigabyte sites. Direct transfer, encryption, scheduled backups and undo are all included.
  • Three ways to move a site. Export and import an archive, transfer directly from server to server, or restore a backup kept on the server.
  • See before you switch. A change preview shows plugin and theme versions, compatibility problems and content counts before anything is touched.
  • Never stuck with a broken site. If the imported site crashes — a critical error or “502 Bad Gateway” — your previous site is restored within seconds, and SiteFerry tells you which plugin caused it.
  • Built not to time out. Small resumable steps and automatic retries work on budget hosting and slow connections.
  • An exact copy. Addresses and paths are updated everywhere, including serialized data, page builder data and generated CSS.
  • Private. Optional AES-256 encrypted archives, encrypted server-to-server transfers, and no third-party services.

Safety Net: migrations you can undo

  • Change preview. New, updated or downgraded plugins and themes, plugins that need a newer PHP or WordPress version, and post, page, media, comment and user counts before and after.
  • Automatic health check. After an import SiteFerry loads the home and login pages. If the site crashes, the previous site is restored automatically and the import is kept so you can re-apply it.
  • Crash diagnosis. SiteFerry turns the imported plugins on in a few quick test requests and names the plugin (or theme) that breaks the site on this server.
  • Crash-proof imports. SiteFerry loads first, so its import, undo and redo requests finish before other plugins load. If you close the browser half-way, the next page view completes the import or restores the previous site.
  • Instant undo and redo. Replaced tables and files are parked, not deleted, for 48 hours. Switching takes seconds for any size and needs no extra disk space.
  • Your choice. On by default; switch it off for a single import if you like.

Three ways to move a site

  • Export → Import. Create an archive, download it, and import it with SiteFerry on another site.
  • Direct site transfer. Create a connection key on the source and paste it on the destination, which pulls everything directly. Keys last 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days or until revoked.
  • Backups. Keep archives on the server, restore them in one click, and schedule automatic backups (twice daily, daily, weekly or monthly) with retention and failure emails.

Built for large sites and slow connections

  • Resumable steps avoid PHP time limits, proxy timeouts and memory limits.
  • Uploads are sent in adaptive pieces, so upload_max_filesize does not apply, and interrupted uploads resume.
  • Downloads resume after an interruption instead of starting again — also behind security proxies.
  • Huge archives can be copied by FTP/SSH into wp-content/siteferry-storage/backups and restored from the list.
  • The database is imported into temporary tables and swapped in with one atomic RENAME TABLE, so the live site is untouched until the end.

You choose what to copy

  • Database with or without users, specific tables, and options to skip spam, revisions and transients.
  • Media, plugins and themes (all, active or none), must-use plugins and other wp-content files, each with a live size estimate.
  • Skip cache folders, development files, large files, extensions or paths. Optional password encryption.
  • On import, choose which parts to bring in and add your own find & replace pairs.
  • Export without users to keep the destination’s accounts and choose who owns the imported content.

Other backup plugins’ folders and SiteFerry’s own files are always left out.

Secure by design

  • Every action needs the manage_options capability and a nonce; running jobs also need a random per-job token.
  • Imports only run the table SQL SiteFerry writes, into temporary tables. Archive paths are checked for traversal and symbolic links are never created.
  • Archives use AES-256-GCM with a 600,000 round PBKDF2 key; direct transfers are signed (HMAC-SHA256) and encrypted.
  • Stored archives get random names and are protected from direct web access.

Unencrypted archives are standard .tar.gz files that any archive tool can open.

For developers

Filters: siteferry_capability, siteferry_time_budget, siteferry_export_table_conditions, siteferry_undo_hours, siteferry_health_targets. Actions: siteferry_import_tables_staged, siteferry_import_complete. Constants: SITEFERRY_STORAGE_DIR (storage location) and SITEFERRY_DELETE_BACKUPS_ON_UNINSTALL.

External services

SiteFerry does not contact any third party service. With the direct transfer, the destination site sends signed requests to the source site address in the connection key you paste, and the source answers with encrypted site data. After an import, the site requests its own home and login pages for the health check.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate SiteFerry from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Open SiteFerry in the admin menu.
  3. To migrate, install SiteFerry on the destination site too.

Requirements: WordPress 6.2+, PHP 7.4+ with zlib, and OpenSSL for encrypted archives and direct transfers.
sections.faq:
Is there a size limit?

No. You only need enough free disk space for the archive, and on the destination for the archive plus the staged site.

What happens to my login when I import?

If the archive contains users, they replace the destination’s users and you log in with an account from the imported site. The import keeps running even though your session ends.

How does undo work?

Replaced tables are renamed and replaced files are moved into SiteFerry’s storage folder on the same disk. Undo swaps them back in seconds. Everything is cleaned up after 48 hours, or when you choose “Keep current & remove”.

Why does SiteFerry load before my other plugins?

So that its own import, undo and redo requests finish before the imported plugins load, and a crashing plugin cannot stop them. On other requests SiteFerry only registers its hooks.

My imported site shows “502 Bad Gateway” on my Mac (Local, MAMP, Valet).

SiteFerry fixes the most common cause automatically: PHP-FPM on macOS crashes when code calls PHP’s gettext() or _() with no language set. Keep SiteFerry active on such a site. For other crashes, the health check restores your previous site and names the cause.

Fonts or background images are missing after a migration.

SiteFerry updates generated CSS in the uploads folder. If a plugin writes addresses into other files, regenerate them from that plugin (for Elementor: Tools → Regenerate CSS & Data).

The archive download never finishes on a company network.

Security proxies such as Zscaler may block backup archives. Use Site Transfer to copy server to server, copy the archive from wp-content/siteferry-storage/backups by SFTP, or ask IT to allow the download.

Where are archives stored?

In wp-content/siteferry-storage/backups, protected from direct access on Apache and IIS. On Nginx, consider moving storage outside the web root with SITEFERRY_STORAGE_DIR in wp-config.php.

My host blocks the REST API. Can I use the direct transfer?

Allow the siteferry/v1 route in your security plugin, or use Export → Import.

Does it support multisite?

Not yet. Imports into multisite networks are refused.

What is removed when I uninstall?

Settings, scheduled events, temporary data and undo points. Archives are kept unless SITEFERRY_DELETE_BACKUPS_ON_UNINSTALL is true.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release: export, import and direct site-to-site transfer with no size limits.
  • Safety Net: change preview, health check with automatic rollback, crash diagnosis, and undo for 48 hours.
  • Scheduled backups, encrypted archives and resumable uploads and downloads.
